plugin.name: Xbox Rain Droplets
enabled.description: Rain, water and blood drops on the screen, as in the Xbox versions of these games. Off: the game's original look.
minsize.description: Size of the smallest drops, in pixels at a screen height of 480; scaled to the resolution.
maxsize.description: Size of the largest drops, in pixels at a screen height of 480; scaled to the resolution.
maxdrops.description: The most drops on the screen at once, including the water trails they leave.
maxmovingdrops.description: The most drops that run across the screen at once.
gravity.description: Some of the drops slowly run down the screen.
refractions.description: Drops show the picture behind them distorted, as through water.
speed.description: How strongly camera movement moves the drops.
movestep.description: Spacing of the trail a running drop leaves, in pixels.
dropblur.description: 0: clear drops that show the picture sharply. 1: soft, blurred drops.
fixedplacement.description: Drops land evenly spread and away from the middle of the screen. Off: drops land at random.
forcerain.description: Shows drops in any weather, for trying out the settings.
debuglog.description: Once a second, writes the values the game passes to the effect into a .log file next to the plugin.
snow.description: Snowflakes on the screen instead of raindrops.
snowsize.description: How large snowflakes on the screen are drawn.
snowamount.description: How much snow lands on the screen.
blooddrops.description: Blood and water sprayed near the camera leave drops on the screen.
rainperday.description: How many hours of the in-game day it rains. 24: rain all the time.
rainchance.description: How likely it is to rain in a race, decided when the race starts.
specialzones.description: Water splashes onto the screen in a few places of the city.
sr2.playerblood.description: The player's own wounds leave blood on the screen too.
sr2.waterguns.description: Water and sewage sprayed at the player or the player's car leave drops on the screen.
sr2.weather.description: Multiplier for the game's rain strength as used for the drops.
